`at3_standalone` is PPSSPP's copy of the ATRAC3 and ATRAC3+ decoders from FFmpeg, taken unchanged from the commit in `SOURCE_COMMIT` (https://github.com/hrydgard/ppsspp/tree/master/ext/at3_standalone). It is licensed under the GNU LGPL 2.1 or later, like FFmpeg. The license text, `at3_standalone/COPYING.LGPLv2.1`, was added here from FFmpeg; the sources themselves are unmodified. `at3_shim` provides the three small PPSSPP headers it expects.
